name: facebookresearch_fasttext/alignment/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_fasttext/alignment/alig.run_word_alignment: run supervised word alignment between source and target embeddings using RCSLS with a bilingual dictionary
facebookresearch_fasttext/alignment/alig.run_alignment_with_sgd: run word alignment optimization using SGD with configurable batch size and learning rate
facebookresearch_fasttext/alignment/alig.run_alignment_with_spectral: run word alignment with spectral projection constraints on the transformation matrix
facebookresearch_fasttext/alignment/alig.run_alignment_with_centering: run word alignment with centered embeddings using the center flag for better alignment quality
facebookresearch_fasttext/alignment/alig.run_alignment_save_output: run word alignment and save aligned embeddings and transformation matrix to output files

facebookresearch_fasttext/alignment/eval.run_word_alignment_evaluation: run the eval script to evaluate word alignment quality on a test dictionary using source and target embeddings
facebookresearch_fasttext/alignment/eval.load_transform_matrix: load a transformation matrix from a text file into a numpy array with configurable dimensions
facebookresearch_fasttext/alignment/eval.compute_nn_accuracy: compute nearest-neighbor accuracy between source and target word embeddings using a bilingual lexicon
facebookresearch_fasttext/alignment/eval.compute_csls_accuracy: compute CSLS cross-lingual similarity accuracy between source and target embeddings for alignment evaluation
facebookresearch_fasttext/alignment/eval.load_and_transform_embeddings: load source and target word embeddings and optionally apply alignment transformation matrices before evaluation

facebookresearch_fasttext/alignment/unsu.run_unsup_align: run the Wasserstein Procrustes script to align source and target word embeddings using a lexicon
facebookresearch_fasttext/alignment/unsu.align_embeddings: align two sets of word embeddings using mini-batch optimal transport and orthogonal projection
facebookresearch_fasttext/alignment/unsu.convex_init_mapping: compute an initial orthogonal mapping between embeddings using convex relaxation and Sinkhorn iterations
facebookresearch_fasttext/alignment/unsu.objective_alignment: evaluate the alignment quality between transformed source and target embeddings using Sinkhorn transport
facebookresearch_fasttext/alignment/unsu.sqrt_eig_matrix: compute the square root of a matrix using SVD decomposition for embedding normalization

facebookresearch_fasttext/alignment/unsu.run_unsup_multialign: run unsupervised multilingual word embedding alignment across multiple languages using a pivot language
facebookresearch_fasttext/alignment/unsu.run_gromov_wasserstein_init: run gromov-wasserstein optimal transport to compute initial bilingual mapping between two embedding sets
facebookresearch_fasttext/alignment/unsu.run_rcsls_optimization: run recursively constructed sparse least squares loss optimization for refining cross-lingual alignment
facebookresearch_fasttext/alignment/unsu.run_align_l2_loss: run L2 loss optimization with sinkhorn transport to align word embeddings across language pairs
facebookresearch_fasttext/alignment/unsu.run_convex_init: run convex initialization with sinkhorn transport to compute an initial orthogonal mapping between embeddings

facebookresearch_fasttext/alignment/util.load_vectors: load word vectors from a text file into numpy arrays with optional normalization and centering
facebookresearch_fasttext/alignment/util.save_vectors: save word vectors and their corresponding words to a text file in standard format
facebookresearch_fasttext/alignment/util.procrustes: compute the orthogonal Procrustes transformation matrix between two sets of vectors using SVD
facebookresearch_fasttext/alignment/util.load_lexicon: load a bilingual lexicon file and map source-target word pairs to vector indices
facebookresearch_fasttext/alignment/util.compute_nn_accuracy: compute nearest neighbor accuracy for cross-lingual word vector alignment using a lexicon
